DitherDonutChart.slices: The slices, each { label, value, color, fill }. A negative value counts as 0. A transparent color takes the next colour of the series: ink, orange, green, pink, purple, blue, red, grey.
DitherDonutChart.label: What the total counts, such as Requests today. Shown in the middle of a donut.
DitherDonutChart.mode: donut is a ring with the total in the middle. pie is full wedges with a card over the lit one.
DitherDonutChart.thickness: Donut only: ring thickness as a share of the radius, 0.1 to 0.9.
DitherDonutChart.gap: Gap between slices, in dither cells.
DitherDonutChart.unit: Written after every value, such as GB. Values are written as whole numbers with separators.
DitherDonutChart.legend: Show the legend. Hover a row to spotlight a slice, click to lock it.
DitherDonutChart.interactive: Hover, click and the legend spotlight.
DitherDonutChart.animated: The slices sweep in clockwise when the chart appears.
DitherDonutChart.matrix: The dither pattern of the gradient fills.
